name: fx-repeat-holds
about: Designed in Session 25 and worked by hand before any code (ENGINE.md section 17, 'Designed 2026-11-24: a repeat holds the nearest note behind it'; D90 item 1, D91). A pattern of eight steps at 120 bpm: sound 1 on step 7 at probability 70, sound 3 on step 3, sound 2 on step 4 and taken out of the effects. The lane is set by edits: effect 11 (every 48 ticks) on steps 1 and 2, effect 12 (every 64 ticks) on steps 5 and 6. Neither run begins on a step that has a note. The first looks back from step 1 across the pattern's wrap and holds step 7, which has not yet played in the first pass: sound 1 fires on the run's grid, carrying step 7's number (the trace's 6) and taking a draw each time. The second looks back from step 5: step 4 has only sound 2, which is out of the effects and does not count, so it holds step 3 and sound 3 fires three times in two steps. The second pass is the first again with the next draws. As the third pass begins sound 1's step 7 is taken off: the first run now finds step 3 behind it, across the wrap, and repeats sound 3. As step 5 of the third pass begins sound 3's step 3 is taken off too: no sound in the effects has a note anywhere, so the second run is silent, and sound 2 has played on throughout.
